data.action: 礼堂花卡旁以淑女姿态整理缎带，确认无人后向镜头淘气眨眼
data.description: 【学生会礼堂·午后】有希穿着端庄白色婚纱坐在宣传板旁，黑色半扎发用紫色缎带固定；她先以淑女姿态整理桌上的花卡，确认四下无人后才对镜头露出“俺模式”的淘气眨眼。
data.lighting: soft afternoon light over violet decorations
data.location: student council hall prepared for a ceremony
data.mood: 淑女端庄与宅系淘气的花嫁切换
data.promptProse: Yuki Suou from Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian wears a white bridal dress with a violet sash, black ribbon veil and a neat half-up hairstyle. She sits beside the student-council flower cards, keeping every ribbon perfectly aligned. Once the formal arrangement is complete, she leans toward the viewer with a playful wink that lets her lively private self peek through the polished bridal pose. soft afternoon light over violet decorations.
data.title: 周防有希 · 学生会礼堂的双面花嫁
